definition: A file of Python code. Python runs it top to bottom, one statement at a time.
shape: the room: the boxes exist in it in reading order

definition: A .py file containing definitions and statements. A program is a module run directly.
shape: the floor of the room; click it for the run's facts

definition: An instruction. Usually one line; executed one by one, in the order written.
shape: box with the code on its face; the working box glows

definition: A group of statements at the same indentation level. Indentation is syntax, not style.
shape: no shape yet; forced by lesson 3

definition: Text after #. Python ignores it completely; it never runs.
shape: no shape: never executes never appears

definition: Code that produces a value.
shape: the ball that appears where the expression's line runs

definition: A physical line of the file. A statement usually ends when the line ends.
shape: the position of a box in the reading-order row

definition: A piece of data. Every value has exactly one type.
shape: ball; color by type

definition: The kind of a value. It determines what the value can do.
shape: the ball's color and form

definition: Text: an ordered sequence of characters. Immutable: it can never change after creation.
shape: ball in the str color

definition: A whole number, of unlimited size.
shape: ball in the int color

definition: A number with a decimal point.
shape: ball in the float color

definition: True or False. The type of every comparison.
shape: ball in the bool color

definition: The absence of a value. What a function returns when it does not return anything.
shape: gray wisp from the chamber's exhaust; dissolves

definition: A value written directly in the code: "hello", 42, True, None.
shape: the ball is born where its line runs

definition: Converting a value to another type: int("42"), str(3.14), float(1).
shape: the ball changes color passing through a conversion chamber

definition: A label bound to a value. Names point at values; the value is not copied.
shape: a tether from the label to the ball

definition: The statement binding a name to a value.
shape: the tether attaches

definition: Binding a name to a new value. The old value is unaffected.
shape: the tether re-aims at a new ball

definition: The standard output stream: where print writes text.
shape: the wall; lines accumulate one strip per print

definition: The builtin function that writes its arguments to stdout as text. It does not modify its arguments, and returns None.
shape: chamber: materializes when called; the argument drops through the aperture; a None wisp leaves the exhaust; projects to the wall

definition: What print writes is str(value): the value's string representation, not the value itself.
shape: the glowing text on the wall strip

definition: A block of code which only runs when it is called. A function can return data as a result.
shape: chamber

definition: The statement that creates a function and binds it to a name. The body does not run yet.
shape: the chamber exists empty and waiting

definition: Runs the function's block, giving it arguments; the call produces the function's return value.
shape: the chamber materializes and works

definition: A name inside the function that receives an argument's value.
shape: the intake aperture of the chamber

definition: A value given to a function in a call.
shape: the ball entering the aperture

definition: The statement that ends the function and produces its return value.
shape: the exhaust emits

definition: The data a call produces. If the function does not return anything, the value is None.
shape: what exits the exhaust: a ball or the None wisp

definition: Where a name is visible: local inside a function, global in the module.
shape: where tethers may attach: inside the chamber or on the floor
